useWhen: Inspect definitions and dependents with the owner symbol-index CLI before reviewing an agent repository change.
avoidWhen: Forest reconciliation or building/pruning a shared index without authorization

outputs.evidence: definition, callers, closure and unresolved index scope

authority.binding: caller authorization and owner-reviewed target repository policy

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; wildcard versions do not establish installation or runtime qualification. Bind source dependencies and effective permissions in the owning repository.
